Comment: AnalysisWorkflow (PRD Section 10 steps 3-7): EnsureCVParsed -> EnsureOfferExtracted -> RunComparisonCrew (waitForTaskToken). Deployment-time Lambda ARNs are substituted into the __..._FUNCTION_ARN__ placeholders by analysis.state_machine.render_definition (plain string replacement, not Python's string.Template, since this file's JSONPaths already use Step Functions' own $/$$ syntax).

EnsureCVParsed.Comment: PRD Section 10 step 4: checks CVVersion.parseStatus; if not PARSED, runs CVExtractionAgent.

EnsureOfferExtracted.Comment: PRD Section 10 step 5: checks JobOffer.extractionStatus; if not READY, runs JobOfferExtractionAgent.

RunComparisonCrew.Comment: PRD Section 10 step 6: Fargate task runs the CrewAI crew and calls SendTaskSuccess/SendTaskFailure with this task's token (Fargate launch itself is M5-T3).
